cells: The job takes one 10-character run parameter, PARM-DATE (INTCALC passes `PARM='2022071800'`); PARM-LENGTH is never checked and PARM-DATE is used only as the TRAN-ID prefix (INT-14), never as a business date.

Files are opened TCATBALF INPUT (indexed, sequential access), XREFFILE INPUT (random, alternate key XREF-ACCT-ID), DISCGRP INPUT (random), ACCTFILE I-O (random) and TRANSACT OUTPUT (sequential, a new SYSTRAN generation), and all five are closed at the end.
DD TCATBALF, XREFFILE, DISCGRP, ACCTFILE, TRANSACT
The driver reads TCATBALF sequentially in key order (account id, type code, category code) until file status `10`, counting and DISPLAYing every record.

On an account break (TRANCAT-ACCT-ID differs from the previous record's), the previous account is updated (INT-17) unless this is the first record, the interest total is reset to zero, and the new account and its card cross-reference are read.

**SME question.** The last account in TCATBALF is never updated: the `ELSE PERFORM 1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT` branch needs END-OF-FILE = `Y` at the top of an iteration, but `PERFORM UNTIL` tests first and exits, so that account's interest transactions are written but its balance and cycle totals are left unchanged.
(no account REWRITE for the last account)
The account is read by TRANCAT-ACCT-ID; a missing account displays `ACCOUNT NOT FOUND` and then abends, because any status other than `00` abends.
The card cross-reference is read by the alternate key XREF-ACCT-ID to get the card number for the interest transaction; a missing cross-reference abends.
The interest rate is looked up in DISCGRP by the key (ACCT-GROUP-ID, TRANCAT-TYPE-CD, TRANCAT-CD).

If the group/type/category key is not found (status `23`), the lookup is retried with group id `DEFAULT` and the same type and category; a failure on the `DEFAULT` read, or any primary status other than `00`/`23`, abends.
A category whose rate is zero produces no interest, no transaction and no fee call.
Monthly interest = TRAN-CAT-BAL × DIS-INT-RATE / 1200 into S9(09)V99 with no ROUNDED and no ON SIZE ERROR, so it truncates to the cent and keeps the sign of the balance.
Each category's monthly interest is added to the account's running total, which is reset to zero at every account break.
One 350-byte interest transaction is written to TRANSACT for each category with a non-zero rate.
TRAN-ID = PARM-DATE (10 bytes) followed by a 6-digit counter that starts at 0 and is incremented before each write for the whole run, not per account.

The interest transaction has type `01`, category `05`, source `System`, description `Int. for a/c ` + ACCT-ID, amount = monthly interest, merchant id 0, blank merchant name/city/zip, and the cross-reference card number.
TRAN-ORIG-TS and TRAN-PROC-TS are both set from `FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE` at write time, formatted `YYYY-MM-DD-HH.MM.SS.hh0000` (26 bytes); the run parameter is not used.
The account update adds the total interest to ACCT-CURR-BAL, sets ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT and ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT to zero, and REWRITEs the account; any status other than `00` abends.
**SME question.** Fees are not computed: `1400-COMPUTE-FEES` holds only a "To be implemented" comment and EXIT, although the job's comment says it computes interest and fees.
Any open, read, write, rewrite or close status other than the expected one DISPLAYs a message and the file status, then abends through `CEE3ABD` with code 999.
On normal completion the program DISPLAYs start and end messages and returns without setting RETURN-CODE (RC 0); there is no reject path and no warning return code.

Files are opened DALYTRAN INPUT (sequential), TRANSACT OUTPUT (indexed by TRAN-ID, random; DD TRANFILE), XREFFILE INPUT (random by card number), DALYREJS OUTPUT (sequential, a new generation), ACCTFILE I-O and TCATBALF I-O (both random), and all six are closed at the end.
DD DALYTRAN, TRANFILE, XREFFILE, DALYREJS, ACCTFILE, TCATBALF

The driver reads DALYTRAN until file status `10`; for each record it adds 1 to the processed count, resets the reason code to 0 and the description to spaces, validates, and posts the record if the reason is still 0, otherwise counts and writes a reject.
Validation order is cross-reference first, then account; the account checks run only when the cross-reference check passed, and no other validations exist (`ADD MORE VALIDATIONS HERE`).
Reason 100: a card number not found in XREFFILE (INVALID KEY) sets reason 100, `INVALID CARD NUMBER FOUND`.
Reason 101: an XREF-ACCT-ID not found in ACCTFILE (INVALID KEY) sets reason 101, `ACCOUNT RECORD NOT FOUND`.
Reason 102: when ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT − ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT + DALYTRAN-AMT is greater than ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT, the record gets reason 102, `OVERLIMIT TRANSACTION`; ACCT-CURR-BAL is not used.

Reason 103: when ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE is less than the first 10 characters of DALYTRAN-ORIG-TS (alphanumeric compare), reason 103 `TRANSACTION RECEIVED AFTER ACCT EXPIRATION` is set; the check runs after the limit check and overwrites a 102.
A rejected record is written to DALYREJS as 430 bytes: the 350-byte DALYTRAN record followed by an 80-byte trailer of reason code 9(04) and description X(76); a write failure abends.
After closing, the program DISPLAYs the processed and rejected counts and sets RETURN-CODE 4 when at least one record was rejected; otherwise RETURN-CODE is not set (RC 0).
A posted transaction copies every DALYTRAN field into TRAN-RECORD except the processing timestamp, which is replaced by the current timestamp (POST-18); the input DALYTRAN-PROC-TS is discarded.
**SME question.** Posting updates the category balance, then the account, then writes the transaction, with no rollback: an abend in a later step leaves the earlier updates in place.
The category balance key is (XREF-ACCT-ID, DALYTRAN-TYPE-CD, DALYTRAN-CAT-CD); status `23` on the read creates a new record, `00` updates the existing one, and any other status abends.
Create path: the record is INITIALIZEd, the key is set, the balance becomes 0 + DALYTRAN-AMT, and the record is WRITTEN; any status other than `00` abends.
Update path: DALYTRAN-AMT is added to TRAN-CAT-BAL and the record is REWRITTEN; any status other than `00` abends.

The account update adds DALYTRAN-AMT to ACCT-CURR-BAL, and also to ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT when the amount is ≥ 0 or to ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT when it is negative (so the debit total accumulates negative values).

**SME question.** Reason 109: an INVALID KEY on the account REWRITE sets reason 109, `ACCOUNT RECORD NOT FOUND`, but nothing reads it afterwards, so the transaction is still written, no reject record is produced, the reject count and RC are unchanged, and the reason is reset for the next record.
The posted transaction is WRITTEN to TRANSACT keyed by TRAN-ID; any status other than `00` (for example a duplicate key) abends.
The processing timestamp comes from `FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE` per record, formatted `YYYY-MM-DD-HH.MM.SS.hh0000` (26 bytes).

Any open, read, write, rewrite or close status other than the expected one DISPLAYs a message and the file status, then abends through `CEE3ABD` with code 999; the two validation reads are the exception, as only their INVALID KEY condition is tested.
